title: Hard-coded AWS access keys
detail: AWS access key AKIA...MAAA written in plain text
fix: Delete the keys, rotate them immediately, and use IAM roles or a secrets manager instead.

title: Secrets in Lambda environment variables
detail: environment variable 'access_key' holds a plain-text secret
fix: Store the secret in Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store and fetch it at runtime.

title: Secrets in Lambda environment variables
detail: environment variable 'secret_key' holds a plain-text secret
fix: Store the secret in Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store and fetch it at runtime.

title: Secrets in EC2 user data
detail: start-up script embeds the secret ${var.password}, which Terraform renders into user data in plain text
fix: Fetch secrets at boot from Secrets Manager using the instance's IAM role.

title: Secrets in EC2 user data
detail: start-up script sets 'secret' in plain text
fix: Fetch secrets at boot from Secrets Manager using the instance's IAM role.

title: Admin port open to the internet
detail: SSH (port 22) open to the whole internet
fix: Allow only known IP ranges, or remove the port and use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

title: Database publicly accessible
detail: database is reachable from the internet (publicly_accessible = true)
fix: Set publicly_accessible = false and reach it through the application or a bastion.

title: Over-broad IAM policy
detail: allows all actions in ec2:*, rds:*, s3:* on every resource
fix: List only the specific actions and resources the role needs.

title: Over-broad IAM policy
detail: allows all actions in cloudwatch:*, ec2:*, lambda:*, s3:* on every resource

title: S3 Block Public Access not configured
detail: no complete S3 Block Public Access configuration, so a later ACL or policy change could expose it
fix: Add aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four settings true.

title: Database backups disabled
detail: automated backups are disabled (backup_retention_period = 0)
fix: Set backup_retention_period to at least 7 days.

title: EBS volume not encrypted
detail: volume is not encrypted, so a snapshot or detached disk exposes its data
fix: Set encrypted = true, or turn on EBS encryption by default for the account.

title: Snapshot of an unencrypted volume
detail: snapshot of the unencrypted volume aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage, so the copy is unencrypted too
fix: Encrypt the source volume, or copy the snapshot with encryption on.

title: Instance metadata allows IMDSv1
detail: instance metadata allows IMDSv1, so an SSRF bug in the app could steal the instance's AWS credentials
fix: Set metadata_options { http_tokens = "required" } to enforce IMDSv2.

title: Instance metadata allows IMDSv1

fix: Set metadata_options { http_tokens = "required" } to enforce IMDSv2.

title: Long-lived IAM access key in Terraform
detail: creates a long-lived access key; its secret is stored in plain text in the Terraform state file
fix: Use IAM roles or AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO) instead of access keys.

title: Search domain not encrypted at rest
detail: search domain data is not encrypted at rest
fix: Enable encrypt_at_rest.

title: Load balancer without TLS
detail: load balancer listens without TLS, so traffic is readable in transit
fix: Use an HTTPS/TLS listener with an ACM certificate and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

title: Kubernetes API endpoint public
detail: Kubernetes API endpoint is reachable from the internet (the default when not set)
fix: Set endpoint_public_access = false, or restrict public_access_cidrs.

title: S3 versioning disabled
detail: versioning is off, so overwritten or deleted objects (e.g. by ransomware) can't be recovered
fix: Enable versioning (aws_s3_bucket_versioning).

detail: access logging is off, so there's no record of who read or changed data
fix: Enable server access logging to a separate log bucket.

title: S3 bucket without a customer-managed KMS key
detail: only AWS's default encryption (SSE-S3): no customer-managed KMS key to control or audit access to the data
fix: Configure default encryption with sse_algorithm = aws:kms and your own key.

title: IAM policy attached directly to a user
detail: permissions attached straight to a user instead of a group or role, which is hard to review and revoke
fix: Attach policies to groups or roles and put users in groups.

title: KMS key rotation disabled
detail: automatic key rotation is off
fix: Set enable_key_rotation = true.

title: Weak container registry settings
detail: image tags can be overwritten, so a tag like 'latest' could be swapped for a malicious image
fix: Set image_tag_mutability = IMMUTABLE and scan_on_push = true.

title: Weak container registry settings
detail: images aren't scanned for vulnerabilities on push
fix: Set image_tag_mutability = IMMUTABLE and scan_on_push = true.
